column1: # PennMUSH function arity, extracted from pennmush/src/function.c FUNTAB flist[].
# One row per entry: NAME <tab> minargs <tab> maxargs, with INF for INT_MAX.
# PennMUSH stores "last argument swallows the rest" as a negative maxargs; this file
# records abs(maxargs), which is the limit parse.c:2980 actually enforces.
